message.content: {"alternatives":[],"likely_cause":{"claim":"Image processing jobs began failing due to the image-resizer workers being terminated by OOMKilled errors caused by exceeding the 4.0 GiB memory limit while decoding large images.","evidence_ids":["log:4","log:7","log:6","log:3"]},"missing_evidence":[],"observations":[{"claim":"The image-resizer service logs show multiple worker terminations due to OOMKilled errors with a 4.0 GiB memory limit.","evidence_ids":["log:4","log:7"]},{"claim":"Warnings indicate the image-resizer workers' RSS memory usage was close to the 4.0 GiB limit while decoding large images (up_2f71 and up_3c88) with sizes around 191 MiB and resolutions up to 14000x10500 px.","evidence_ids":["log:6","log:3"]},{"claim":"The upload-gateway service logs report resize job failures and warnings that 63 of 1204 jobs failed in the last 30 minutes, all with source images above 150 MiB.","evidence_ids":["log:9","log:5"]},{"claim":"The image-resizer service enabled codec pipeline v4 at 100 percent rollout, which decodes full-resolution frames before downsampling, potentially increasing memory usage compared to the previous v3 pipeline that downsampled during decode.","evidence_ids":["log:1","log:8"]}],"outcome":"supported","suggested_checks":["Check memory usage and limits of image-resizer workers during processing of large images.","Review the impact of codec pipeline v4 on memory consumption compared to v3.","Inspect the size and resolution of images being processed to identify if large images are causing memory pressure.","Monitor upload-gateway failure rates and correlate with image sizes."]}
